name: 4-PrO-DMT
summary: 4-PrO-DMT, also known as 4-propionyloxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine or as O-propionylpsilocin, is a synthetic psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family with psychedelic that is believed to act as a prodrug of psilocin (4-HO-DMT). It has been sold online as a designer drug since May 2019. It was first identified as a new psychoactive substance in Sweden, in July 2019.

pharmacology.text: 4-PrO-DMT is theorized to be a serotonergic psychedelic, and is partial agonist of the 5-HT1D, 5-HT1B and 5-HT1A serotonin receptors. It produces the head-twitch response in mice.
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: 4-PrO-DMT is reported to be orally active and while effects have been studied in mice, its effects and longevity on humans have not been formally studied. The effects of 4-PrO-DMT are similar to those of psilocin (4-HO-DMT), as it acts as a prodrug of this compound. This is analogous to the case of 4-AcO-DMT and psilocybin (4-PO-DMT).

summaryZh: 4-PrO-DMT是一種具有迷幻效果的色胺類藥物，是脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（賽洛辛）的前體藥物。它會在小鼠體內產生頭部抽搐反應。它自從2019年5月便作為狡詐家藥物在網上銷售，並在同年7月於瑞典被確定為一種新的精神活性物質。
summaryZhHans: 4-PrO-DMT是一种具有迷幻效果的色胺类药物，是脱磷酸裸盖菇素（赛洛辛）的前体药物。它会在小鼠体内产生头部抽搐反应。它自从2019年5月便作为狡诈家药物在网上销售，并在同年7月于瑞典被确定为一种新的精神活性物质。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Because it is thought to turn into psilocin in the body, its effects are expected to resemble magic mushrooms: nausea, yawning, dilated pupils, muscle tension, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, such drugs can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。由於一般認為它會在體內轉變成脫磷酸裸蓋菇素，預期它的作用會類似迷幻蘑菇：噁心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，這類藥物可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。由于一般认为它会在体内转变成脱磷酸裸盖菇素，预期它的作用会类似迷幻蘑菇：恶心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，这类药物可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Its better-known cousin, 4-AcO-DMT or psilacetin, was patented by Albert Hofmann and Franz Troxler at Sandoz in 1963. 4-PrO-DMT uses a slightly longer propionyl cap on the same psilocin core.
fact.zh: 它較知名的近親4-AcO-DMT（psilacetin）於1963年由Sandoz公司的Albert Hofmann與Franz Troxler取得專利。4-PrO-DMT則在相同的脫磷酸裸蓋菇素核心上，加了一個稍長的丙醯基。
fact.zhHans: 它较知名的近亲4-AcO-DMT（psilacetin）于1963年由Sandoz公司的Albert Hofmann与Franz Troxler取得专利。4-PrO-DMT则在相同的脱磷酸裸盖菇素内核上，加了一个稍长的丙酰基。
